title: Vector Dummy Logs Dashboard
description: Volume over time, breakdown by log level, and top services for the Vector demo_logs load generator.

panels.title: Log Volume Over Time
panels.description: Count of ingested log events per minute

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS "x_axis_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "dummy_logs" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Breakdown by Log Level
panels.description: Share of events per log level over the selected time range

queries.query: SELECT log_level AS "x_axis_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "dummy_logs" GROUP BY log_level ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Top Services by Log Volume
panels.description: Services generating the most log events

queries.query: SELECT service AS "x_axis_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "dummy_logs" GROUP BY service ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Error Log Rate Over Time
panels.description: ERROR-level events per minute, useful as a quick health signal

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS "x_axis_1", count(*) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "dummy_logs" WHERE log_level = 'ERROR' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
